_doc: Plan 169 Imperial Reward Seals (2026-11-05 patch, research 0044). categories: the six per-category seals [{id, name, source, verified, verify?}] in this fixed order. golden: the Golden Seal row {id, name, converts (YYYY-MM-DD; resolved to that date's maintenance start), rate (null = not announced, else the official wording, ASCII), note, source, verified, verify?}. exchange: [{id = <category>-<slug(item)>, category, item, cost (seals of that category), limit (per family, null = none listed), source, verified}]; the exchange tables were not read row by row in research 0044, so none is seeded - the operator adds rows on the card until an official page is read. verified stays false until an official page matches (plan 085 verifier).

golden.name: Golden Seal
golden.note: Golden Seals convert to per-category Reward Seals at the 2026-12-03 maintenance; the conversion rate was not announced in the 2026-11-05 patch notes.
